full_judgment: The petitioners, joint Mutawallis of Saber Khan Wakf Estate filed O.C. Suit No.5 of 1969 in the Court of subordinate Judge, Noakhali for declaration that the suit properties of the Wakf Estate were not affected by Ordinance III of 1956 and by the Special Notification of 1954 and prayed for restraining the respondents from interfering with the management and collection of rents by them till proper annuity is fixed and compensation is assessed for the tenanted and khas lands of the Wakf Estate.
